task.title: P6-148: Fix three quick-add keystroke-loop bugs: Escape, stale count, history spam
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 4 — Correctness, ⌘K palette and quick-add). Original id: P6-148. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md.

**Three quick-add interaction bugs that all live in the same keystroke loop** (was `P6-069b` + `P6-069c` + `P6-069f` + `P6-069g`): `Escape` decodes to `Pass` when `rows == 0`, so Escape cannot close a panel open with no candidates (outside-click still can); the two early-return failure paths in `add` (no destination; Have with no printing) leave `count` set, so a subsequent `⏎` without typing re-uses it; the post-add `clear()` commits `""` with `replace = false`, so **every add pushes a history entry**; and after Escape the field keeps focus, so `focusin` cannot re-fire and reopening needs a click away and back.
